name: Ryan Brosas Brand System
description: A practical, failure-aware brand system for explaining and presenting agent systems that remove recurring work from overworked founders.

logo.notes: Use the charcoal mark on light surfaces, coral as a controlled accent, signal yellow on charcoal, and white on charcoal or coral. Preserve the 255 × 211 geometry and optically center the visible glyph.

colors.name: Near-white paper
colors.usage: Primary reading canvas and light surface.

colors.name: Paper surface
colors.usage: Base panel surface; raised steps are derived with color-mix().

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.usage: Primary text, structural rules, and preferred dark canvas.

colors.name: Muted charcoal
colors.usage: Apply charcoal at 68% opacity for supporting text.

colors.name: Structural rule
colors.usage: Apply charcoal at 16% opacity for fine borders.

colors.name: Coral
colors.usage: Primary actions, selected states, expressive rules, and accent mark.

colors.name: Signal yellow
colors.usage: Scarce focus cue, Open state, and protected logo tile.

display.notes: Normal-width display face; create energy through scale and alignment, not condensed geometry.

body.notes: Comfortable long-viewing body text with 1.55–1.65 line height.

mono.notes: Use only for indices, labels, status, specifications, and technical evidence.

rules: Create editorial energy through scale, alignment, repetition, and crop.
Reserve mono for indices, status, specifications, tokens, and technical evidence.

voice.tone: A practical builder thinking through real systems in public, reporting failures plainly and avoiding hype.
messagingPillars: Show context, checks, handoffs, and recovery.
Share what worked, what broke, and what remains Open.
deliveryRules: Lead with the operating consequence, then explain the mechanism.
Name the evidence source when a claim is Verified.
State the tradeoff when a recommendation is Proposed.
Use 'Still needed:' when proof remains Open.
Prefer one concrete sentence over a stack of abstract benefits.

acceptanceTest.passesWhen: The copy names the work, the system choice, the evidence boundary, and the next step without hype.
acceptanceTest.failsWhen: The copy could belong to any AI consultancy after replacing the name.

imagery.style: Owned operational evidence with concentrated editorial scale reserved for presentation moments.
imagery.treatment: Contain screenshots inside clear evidence plates; use strong crops and image/type tension only when the proof remains readable.

samples.caption: Calm operational grid and system chain.
Inspectable brand rules and logo contexts.

postureRules: Keep workbench surfaces calm, flat, modular, and readable.
Reserve collage, large crops, and abrupt scale shifts for presentation moments.
Use one decisive visual flourish per screen.
Repeat coral and ration signal yellow.
Center the visible logo glyph optically inside every tile.

identity.name: Ryan Brosas
identity.primaryStatement: I build agent systems so repetitive work stops coming back to you.
identity.campaignLine: Building systems so everything doesn’t need you.

audience.primary: Overworked founders whose recurring work and decisions still route back through them.
audience.secondary: Operators, agency owners, developers, and advanced builders working on context, evaluation, handoffs, and reliability.

components.navigation: Three primary workbook pages plus secondary Personal and Client track controls.
components.button: Primary, secondary, quiet, selected, loading, disabled, and focus-visible states.
components.panel: Low-radius evidence module using semantic surface, text, stroke, and status roles.
components.form: Visible label, 44px input, plain-language invalid message, and non-color validation cue.
components.status: Verified, Proposed, and Open are written labels and must not rely on color alone.
components.themeControl: A labelled light/dark preference that writes data-theme on the owned root and persists locally.
components.projectEvidence: A request for owned proof; never a polished fake screenshot.

assets.referenceBoardUsage: Contained inspiration only; do not copy third-party material.
